text:
You need a Python Django developer who can build secure, efficient, testable REST APIs and integrate data systems without sacrificing performance.  

I bring 7 years of full-stack experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API work, and Stripe integrations. On Charity admin modernisation, I upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt donation entry with HTMX, cutting donation entry time by 45% while preserving zero data loss across 180k donor records. On Booking platform for fitness studios, I built a white-label class booking app with subdomains, timetables, and memberships; 64 studios onboarded in 6 months and checkout conversion reached 71%.  

I’d be glad to apply that same care to your Django project. What part of the system needs the most attention first: API design, data integration, or authentication?
